item.title: Anthropic Launches Workplace Suite, Sending Microsoft Shares Down 3.5%
item.description:
Anthropic unveiled native workplace software including Claude Sheets and Claude Data, letting users generate collaborative spreadsheets and self-updating dashboards from plain-language prompts, with Adobe, Atlassian and Box embedded directly in chat. The move shifts Claude from an add-in to a standalone productivity platform competing with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, and Microsoft shares fell more than 3.5% after the announcement.

原文标题：Anthropic 推出办公套件 微软股价应声下跌 3.5%

Why it matters：AI 厂商首次以原生办公套件正面挑战 Office 生态，并引发资本市场即时反应，是产业格局变化的重要信号。

item.title: Oura Acquires AI-Native Primary Care Startup Counsel Health for $625M
item.description:
Smart ring maker Oura announced it will acquire AI-native primary care company Counsel Health for $625 million, folding chat-based medical AI plus licensed physician access into the Oura app and expanding into preventative, acute, and chronic care. The deal follows Oura's indefinite postponement of its up-to-$2.2B IPO, signaling a strategy to build a closed-loop health service and fend off rivals like RingConn and Ultrahuman.

原文标题：Oura 以 6.25 亿美元收购 AI 初级诊疗公司 Counsel Health

Why it matters：大额并购叠加 AI 医疗落地与 IPO 推迟，是硬件厂商向 AI 健康服务转型的标志性产业事件。

item.title: Amazon Debuts Indoor Security Drone That Flies to Alarms
item.description:
Amazon has introduced a self-flying indoor security drone and a ground rover for its Ring ecosystem, both dispatched automatically to preset waypoints when an alarm trips so video may already be streaming before the user opens the alert. The drone rests in its dock with the camera off, records only during flights, uses deliberately loud propellers as a deterrent, and ships with Ring's strongest default encryption.

原文标题：亚马逊推出室内安防无人机 警报触发即自主起飞

Why it matters：这是消费级安防硬件首次把自主飞行机器人纳入家庭报警闭环，涉及自动调度与隐私设计取舍，值得关注。

item.title: Inkbox Raises $5.3M to Give AI Agents Persistent Hosted Computers
item.description:
Inkbox raised $5.3M led by Peak XV Partners and launched hosted agents that run alongside their own email, phone, iMessage, WhatsApp and A2A channels, with scheduling and a persistent computer that sleeps when idle. The company says it has processed millions of agent messages in the four months since its YC launch.

Why it matters：为智能体补齐可寻址通信身份与持久运行环境，是智能体基础设施层值得关注的早期融资与产品落地。

item.title: Anthropic Launches IPO Seeking Up to $64.4 Billion
item.description:
Anthropic set an IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share in its second S-1 amendment, offering up to 825 million shares for a valuation of as much as $1.4 trillion and roughly $64.4 billion in proceeds, with about $62.5 billion flowing to the company via 801 million new shares. The filing also formally declares that Anthropic has crossed a Responsible Scaling Policy threshold where AI meaningfully accelerates AI research, a call based on expectations for future models rather than demonstrated current capabilities.

原文标题：Anthropic 启动 IPO 最高募资 644 亿美元

Why it matters：万亿美元级 IPO 定价与负责任扩展政策阈值首次正式触发，是 AI 产业资本化与安全治理的双重标志性事件。

item.title: PSI Uses AI to Crack 18-Year-Old Quantum Computing Conjecture
item.description:
Startup lab Physical Superintelligence (PSI) used early access to Anthropic's Fable 5.2 model to solve the 18-year-old Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture in quantum computing, and is now trying to build a business around AI-driven scientific discovery. The proof was autoformalized in Lean and reviewed by top researchers, marking a landmark case of AI directly producing frontier mathematical results.

原文标题：PSI 用 AI 攻克 18 年量子计算猜想

Why it matters：这是 AI 直接产出前沿数学证明并尝试商业化的标志性事件，对关注 AI for Science 的读者具有高参考价值。

item.title: NaiveAI Debuts Open-Weights Coding Model at 2,100 Tokens per Second
item.description:
Chinese startup NaiveAI has released Naive-N0.5-Flash, an open-weights model tuned for AI coding tasks and optimized for maximum tokens-per-second throughput, claiming up to 2,100 tokens/sec. Built on Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.5 with further long-context training and paired with its own NaiveRT inference engine, the model trades slightly higher per-question cost for speed, targeting latency-sensitive engineering workflows.

Why it matters：开源编码模型以极致推理速度切入，为延迟敏感的 AI 编程场景提供新选择。

item.title: OpenAI Launches Business Profiles to Turn ChatGPT Into a Discovery Engine
item.description:
OpenAI has launched a beta Business Hub that lets companies create and verify business profiles and deploy dedicated business agents, so ChatGPT users can ask about products and services directly. The move positions ChatGPT closer to a Google-style commercial discovery and search gateway, extending its earlier e-commerce ambitions.

item.title: Nvidia Unveils GR00T 2 to Learn Robot Skills from Human Video
item.description:
Nvidia has introduced GR00T 2, a robotics foundation model that departs from directly mapping camera images and language commands to motor actions. Instead, the model watches humans in video and internally imagines itself performing the motion as a robot before producing control signals, aiming to sharply reduce costly and slow teleoperation data collection.

原文标题：英伟达发布 GR00T 2 从人类视频学习机器人动作

Why it matters：英伟达机器人基础模型代际更新，提出以视频人类动作替代遥操作的新训练范式，对具身智能路线有实质参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Kicks Off IPO Roadshow at Up to $1.4 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic has launched its IPO roadshow, planning to sell up to 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each, implying a valuation of as much as $1.4 trillion and roughly $64.4 billion in proceeds. About $62.5 billion comes from 801 million new shares, with existing holders selling only 23.6 million, so nearly all cash funds the company. The range is down from earlier talk of $2 trillion amid a tech selloff and post-midterm signals of voter unease over AI data centers, yet still tops OpenAI's $1.25 trillion private valuation. Trading is expected on Nasdaq under ticker ANT as soon as next Thursday or Friday.

Why it matters：这是 AI 头部公司迄今规模最大的公开上市动作，直接重塑行业估值锚与资本格局。

item.title: DeepMind and Artificial Analysis Launch MKA Multimodal Agent Benchmark
item.description:
Google DeepMind and Artificial Analysis have partnered to launch MKA (Multimodal Knowledge Agent), a benchmark evaluating how well agents handle visually complex tasks such as cross-referencing blueprints and reading scientific charts, which existing evaluations do not cover. Gemini 4 Carbon ranks second on the benchmark at 6x lower average cost per task than the top model.

item.title: Google DeepMind Launches MKA Benchmark for Multimodal Knowledge Agents
item.description:
Google DeepMind, in partnership with Artificial Analysis, launched the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) evaluation, a benchmark of 200 private real-world visual tasks spanning 10 industries. Agents must interpret dense visual files such as architectural drawings, engineering schematics and clinical scans, then produce deliverables including slide decks, spreadsheets and reports. Scoring uses expert rubrics split into Climb and Regression criteria, averaging about 70 weighted items per task, with Claude Sonnet 5.5 leading in several domains.

原文标题：Google DeepMind 发布 MKA 多模态知识智能体基准

Why it matters：这是面向真实视觉知识工作的智能体评测新基准，任务设计与评分方法具备实质参考价值。

item.title: MBZUAI Releases PAN 2 Open World Model for Simulative Reasoning
item.description:
MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models released PAN 2, an open foundation world model for physical intelligence built around simulative reasoning that lets agents play out outcomes before acting. It splits reasoning into two tracks: an LLM determines what happens, when, and how the camera moves and writes it as text, while a 29B diffusion model trained from scratch renders that text into visuals. Ablating the LLM collapses multi-step performance to 8.7% correct steps with no completed plans, whereas the combined system reaches 75.1% correct steps and 34.0% fully completed plans.

原文标题：MBZUAI 开源 PAN 2 世界模型 支持仿真推理

Why it matters：开源世界模型叠加 LLM 与扩散双路推理，并给出清晰的消融数据，对具身智能与智能体规划方向有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Carbon for Multi-Step Coding and Research
item.description:
Google has made Gemini 4 Carbon generally available after a two-week testing phase, positioning it for demanding work such as multi-step coding, debugging and scientific research, complementing Gemini 4 Argon at the cost of higher token consumption. Google also previewed the /swarm feature in Antigravity, which turns a single prompt into a coordinated team of agents. Arriving amid rapid rival releases, the launch already feels late in the current model cycle.

原文标题：谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Carbon 主打多步编码与科研

Why it matters：谷歌正式开放新一代高强度任务模型并预览多智能体协同功能，是模型能力与智能体形态的双重信号。

The company reports customers achieving over $1M in annualized savings, 5+ hours saved per accounting team per day, a 77% cut in annual TMS costs, and reporting times reduced from hours to under a minute.

item.title: OpenAI Study Maps How AI Is Reshaping Freelance Work
item.description:
OpenAI's Economic Research Team, in research with Upwork, finds that AI is reshaping demand in the freelance market: traditional service categories are losing share, while AI-related projects bundle multiple capabilities and command larger budgets and more hours. Because freelance contracts are short and requirements shift quickly, the market can signal AI-driven structural change earlier than economy-wide employment data.

原文标题：OpenAI 研究揭示 AI 对自由职业市场的重塑

Why it matters：来自 OpenAI 经济研究团队的一手实证研究，为观察 AI 对劳动力市场的结构性影响提供了早期量化信号。

item.title: Chrome and Browser Giants Launch Modern Web Skills for Coding Agents
item.description:
Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox and MDN have jointly released Modern Web Guidance, a skill set that embeds web platform best practices and browser compatibility data directly into coding agents to steer them away from legacy JavaScript patterns. It ships with an npx install wizard and a legacy-scan detector trained on 30k GitHub repos to flag outdated patterns for modernization.

item.title: Otto One Launches a Dedicated Home Computer for AI Agents
item.description:
Otto One is a small home computer built to host AI agents that run continuously on-device, handling email triage, account chasing and admin tasks on a schedule without data leaving the box. Its key innovation is routing: simple jobs go to a local model, with paid cloud models like Claude or GPT-4o invoked only when needed, cutting per-request costs. Agents ship pre-configured, 2,000+ apps connect with one tap, and users approve actions remotely from a phone.

原文标题：Otto One 发布 为智能体打造本地专属主机

Why it matters：提出智能体本地常驻硬件加本地/云端混合路由的落地形态，切中隐私与调用成本两大痛点。

item.title: Berkeley Study Finds Model Routing Cuts Costs Up to 25x
item.description:
UC Berkeley and partner labs released a large-scale model routing study spanning 452 candidate models and policies across 25 benchmarks, totaling 374,401 scored runs. Routers deliver their value mainly by shifting work to cheaper models, averaging 8.82x more quality per unit cost with under 0.5 points lost; on coding tasks routing reached 25.5x the cost efficiency of always calling Opus 4.6 at a 0.44-point loss. Yet learned routers gained only 0.3 points over the best single model, far below the 5.4-point theoretical ceiling.

原文标题：伯克利研究揭示模型路由降本 25 倍

Why it matters：首个跨文本问答到机器人控制的统一路由评测，给出可复用的成本效率量化结论。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: BaoCut Unveils Layered Puppet-Style Virtual Anchor Pipeline
item.description:
BaoCut released a virtual anchor pipeline that generates a front-facing portrait with AI, splits it into 27 layers via pixel-level comparison, and drives head turns with mesh deformation plus 17 spring-like hair parameters. Lip sync is matched per-character pronunciation rather than volume, firing 0.03 seconds ahead of audio. The skeleton and deformation logic are ported from the Apache-2.0 LivLiv Player, avatars come from Seedream 5.5, and a skill install lets agents like Claude Code and Codex handle scripting, dubbing and review end to end.

原文标题：BaoCut 开源虚拟主播方案 拆解 27 层皮影动画

Why it matters：给出了一套可复用的分层驱动虚拟主播工程路径，并展示了 Agent skill 化落地的具体形态。

item.title: 云开发平台 Val Town 宣布关停并将开源
item.description:
云开发与托管平台 Val Town 宣布因无法在云计算市场立足而停止运营，即日起暂停计费并免费服务存量订阅用户，年付用户将获部分退款。服务将于 2027 年 1 月 10 日全面终止，代码计划于 2027 年 2 月 1 日开源，官方同时提供迁移至 Cloudflare、Vercel、Netlify 与 Render 的指南。

Why it matters：一家开发者平台因算力竞争失利而关停并承诺开源，是观察云基础设施与 AI 辅助迁移趋势的行业信号。

item.title: Google 向全体付费开发者开放 Gemini 4 Carbon
item.description:
